# NDjourney

> A private digital home for a couple's story: milestones, photos, notes, letters, wishes, and a small map of where they are.

## Public pages

- [Beranda](https://ndjourney.vercel.app/): hero, countdowns, latest photos, love meter, and previews of the shared story.
- [Timeline](https://ndjourney.vercel.app/timeline): milestones in chronological order.
- [Gallery](https://ndjourney.vercel.app/gallery): public photo albums.
- [Notes](https://ndjourney.vercel.app/notes): short daily notes.
- [Letters](https://ndjourney.vercel.app/letters): public letters.
- [Wishlist](https://ndjourney.vercel.app/wishlist): shared wishes and progress.
- [Games](https://ndjourney.vercel.app/games): couple quizzes and memory games.

## Notes

- Dashboard, account, and API routes are private and require authentication.
- Content is authored by the couple; public pages are read-only for visitors.
